title: 第十一章 陆吾守卫第十二章 钦原毒针
lines: 第十一章：陆吾守卫
伤口感染比想象中来得更快。
昆仑山腹地的低温延缓了血液的凝固，却加速了某种厌氧菌的繁殖。黄海涛小腿上的伤口在几个小时内就红肿发黑，边缘呈现出一种诡异的荧光绿色。每一次心跳，毒素都随着血液向心脏蔓延，带来一阵阵深入骨髓的剧痛和幻觉。
他看到了实验室的车祸现场，看到了那辆失控的油罐车变成了一只长着翅膀的红色巨龟；他看到了李元茜的脸在眼前分裂、重叠，一会儿是那个严肃的古生物学家，一会儿是招摇山上那个背生发光菌毯的狌狌。
“黄老师！醒醒！”
李元茜的声音像一根针，刺破了他混沌的意识。她正跪在雪地里，用最后一点医用酒精清洗他的伤口，再用加热过的清水冲洗。她的手在抖，不是因为冷，是因为恐惧。
“我们不能……再往前走了。”李元茜的声音带着哭腔，“你的腿如果不处理，会截肢的。我们需要抗生素，需要……”
她的话戛然而止。
因为在她前方不到二十米的雪坡上，一个身影正静静地矗立在那里。
是陆吾。
那个在峡谷入口处放他们通过的“司天之九部”守卫。
它此刻的姿态与之前完全不同。它不再是慵懒趴伏的巨兽，而是完全直立的、高达三米的战斗姿态。它那虎身九尾的躯体上覆盖着一层薄薄的冰霜，在月光下泛着冷冽的寒光。九条蛇尾不再是松散下垂，而是像九柄出鞘的利剑，呈扇形展开，每一颗蛇头上的竖瞳都死死锁定着两人，尤其是……黄海涛那条受伤的腿。
“它在……闻味道？”李元茜压低声音，心脏狂跳。
陆吾的人头微微低下，那个长着猫瞳的“神”并没有发出任何声音，但它的九条蛇尾却开始以一种极高频的幅度颤动起来。空气中传来一阵几乎听不见的、类似小提琴g弦被拉到极限的嗡鸣。
紧接着，陆吾动了。
它没有冲锋，也没有咆哮。它只是缓缓抬起一只前爪——那只虎爪此刻正散发着淡淡的、如同玉石般的荧光——然后对着空气，轻轻一划。
一道肉眼可见的空气刃凭空出现，擦着两人头顶飞过，将身后一棵两人合抱的沙棠树拦腰斩断。断口平滑如镜，甚至连木纤维的纹路都被切断得整整齐齐。
警告。
这是赤裸裸的驱逐令。
“它嫌我们脏了。”李元茜瞬间明白了，“伤口的脓液，还有现代药物的味道，对它来说是不可容忍的污染源。”
“走……不走得了吗？”黄海涛咬着牙，试图撑起身体，但剧痛让他再次瘫软下去。
陆吾似乎失去了耐心。它那九条蛇尾同时扬起，这一次，不再是威慑，而是杀招。九颗蛇头张开了血盆大口，从口中喷出了九道细长的、如同高压水枪般的白色雾气。
那不是水，是液氮。
极寒的雾气瞬间覆盖了两人周围的半径五米范围。地面上的积雪瞬间硬化成冰壳，空气中的水分瞬间凝华成冰晶。李元茜只觉得一股刺骨的寒意顺着毛孔钻进骨髓，她甚至能听到自己睫毛结冰的声音。
“跑！”她用尽全身力气，背起已经意识模糊的黄海涛，踉跄着向侧面的岩壁冲去。
轰！
九道液氮束轰在他们刚才所在的位置，地面瞬间被冻裂，炸开一个深坑，坑底结满了厚厚的白霜。
陆吾没有追击。它只是站在原地，像一座雕塑，冷漠地看着这两个渺小的闯入者在它的领地上狼狈逃窜。它似乎在等待，等待他们自行消亡，或者……自行离开。
李元茜背着黄海涛，躲进了一处巨大的、向内凹陷的岩洞。这岩洞是天然的，但洞口却被一道巨大的、半透明的生物膜封死了一半，那膜还在微微搏动，像活物一样。
“放下他。”一个声音在洞内响起。
李元茜猛地回头，心脏几乎停跳。
在岩洞深处，一个身影正盘腿坐在冰冷的岩石上。
是那个红发女人。
她依旧赤足，但身上多了一件用某种白色兽毛编织的长袍。她手里不再拿着那根发光权杖，而是捧着一个陶碗，碗里盛着某种冒着热气的、乳白色的液体。
看到李元茜和她背上的黄海涛，红发女人脸上没有任何意外。她只是缓缓抬起手，指了指岩洞角落里一堆干燥的、像是鸟巢一样的枯草。
“放下他。”她重复了一遍，这次用的是一种更清晰的、带着奇特韵律的语言，但李元茜竟然奇异地听懂了。
是迷榖树花粉的后遗症？还是某种跨物种的潜意识沟通？
李元茜来不及多想，小心翼翼地将黄海涛放在那堆枯草上。他的脸色已经由苍白转为青紫，呼吸微弱得几乎感觉不到。
红发女人站起身，走到黄海涛身边。她没有检查伤口，而是伸出一根手指，轻轻点在他的额头。
嗡。
一股暖流顺着她的指尖传入黄海涛的体内。李元茜惊讶地看到，黄海涛脸上那层诡异的青光竟然消退了一些。
然后，红发女人从怀里掏出一个小皮囊，倒出一些灰色的粉末，混合在陶碗的液体里，搅拌均匀。那液体散发出一股浓烈的、类似艾草和硫磺混合的气味。

Chapter 11: Lu Wu Guards
1.
Wound infection occurs faster than expected.
The low temperature in the hinterland of the Kunlun Mountains delays the coagulation of blood, but accelerates the reproduction of certain anaerobic bacteria. The wound on Huang Haitao's calf became red, swollen and black within a few hours, and the edges showed a strange fluorescent green color. With every heartbeat, toxins spread to the heart along with the blood, causing waves of severe pain and hallucinations that penetrate deep into the bone marrow.
He saw the car accident scene in the laboratory, and saw the out-of-control oil tanker turning into a giant red turtle with wings; he saw Li Yuanqian's face split and overlapped in front of his eyes, sometimes it was the serious paleontologist, and sometimes it was the unicorn with a luminous fungus blanket on its back on Mount Zhaoyao.
"Teacher Huang! Wake up!"
Li Yuanqian's voice was like a needle, piercing his chaotic consciousness. She was kneeling in the snow, cleaning his wound with the last bit of medical alcohol and then rinsing it with heated water. Her hands were shaking, not because of cold, but because of fear.
"We can't... go any further." Li Yuanqian's voice was filled with tears, "If your leg is not treated, it will be amputated. We need antibiotics, we need..."
Her words stopped abruptly.
Because on the snowy slope less than twenty meters in front of her, a figure was standing there quietly.
It's Lu Wu.
The "Nine Divisions of Si Tian" guard who let them pass at the entrance of the canyon.
Its posture now is completely different from before. It is no longer a lazy and lying giant beast, but a fully upright, three-meter-high fighting posture. Its body with a tiger body and nine tails was covered with a thin layer of frost, glowing coldly in the moonlight. The nine snake tails were no longer loose and drooping, but were like nine unsheathed swords, spread out in a fan shape. The vertical pupils on each snake's head were locked firmly on the two of them, especially... Huang Haitao's injured leg.
"Is it... smelling?" Li Yuanqian lowered her voice, her heart beating rapidly.
Lu Wu lowered his head slightly. The "god" with cat eyes did not make any sound, but its nine snake tails began to tremble at an extremely high frequency. There was an almost inaudible hum in the air, similar to the g-string of a violin being stretched to its limit.
Immediately afterwards, Lu Wu moved.
It didn't charge or roar. It just slowly raised one of its front paws - the tiger paw was emitting a faint, jade-like fluorescence at the moment - and then made a light stroke towards the air.
laugh--!
An air blade visible to the naked eye appeared out of thin air, flew over the two people's heads, and cut off the middle of a Shatang tree behind them that they were hugging. The fracture was as smooth as a mirror, and even the grain of the wood fiber was cut neatly.
warn.
This is a naked deportation order.
"It thinks we are dirty." Li Yuanqian understood instantly, "The pus from the wound and the smell of modern medicine are intolerable sources of pollution for it."
"Can't we walk?" Huang Haitao gritted his teeth and tried to hold himself up, but the severe pain made him collapse again.
Lu Wu seemed to have lost his patience. Its nine snake tails were raised at the same time. This time, it was no longer a deterrent, but a killing move. The nine snake heads opened their bloody mouths and sprayed out nine slender white mists like high-pressure water guns.
That's not water, that's liquid nitrogen.
The extremely cold fog instantly covered a five-meter radius around the two people. The snow on the ground instantly hardened into an ice shell, and the moisture in the air instantly condensed into ice crystals. Li Yuanqian felt a biting chill running down her pores into her bones, and she could even hear the sound of her eyelashes freezing.
"Run!" She used all her strength to pick up Huang Haitao, who was already unconscious, and staggered towards the rock wall on the side.
boom!
Nine liquid nitrogen beams hit the location where they were just now, and the ground was instantly frozen and cracked, a deep pit exploded, and the bottom of the pit was covered with thick white frost.
Lu Wu did not pursue. It just stood there, like a sculpture, watching indifferently as these two tiny intruders fled in confusion in its territory. It seems to be waiting, waiting for them to die on their own, or... to leave on their own.
Li Yuanqian carried Huang Haitao on her back and hid in a huge, sunken cave. This cave is natural, but the entrance is half sealed by a huge, translucent biofilm, which is still pulsing slightly, like a living thing.
"Put him down." A voice sounded in the cave.
Li Yuanxi turned around suddenly, her heart almost stopping.
Deep in the cave, a figure was sitting cross-legged on the cold rock.
It's the red-haired woman.
She was still barefoot, but she had an extra robe woven from some kind of white animal hair. She no longer held the glowing scepter in her hand, but instead held an earthenware bowl filled with some kind of steaming, milky white liquid.
Seeing Li Yuanqian and Huang Haitao on her back, the red-haired woman had no surprise on her face. She just slowly raised her hand and pointed at a pile of dry, bird's nest-like grass in the corner of the cave.
"Put him down." She repeated, this time using a clearer language with a strange rhythm, but Li Yuanqian surprisingly understood it.
Is it the aftereffects of the pollen from the Myrtle tree? Or some kind of cross-species subconscious communication?
Li Yuanqian didn't have time to think too much, and carefully placed Huang Haitao on the pile of withered grass. His face had turned from pale to purple, and his breathing was so weak that he could hardly feel it.
The red-haired woman stood up and walked to Huang Haitao. She did not check the wound, but stretched out a finger and lightly touched his forehead.
Buzz.
A warm current flowed into Huang Haitao's body along her fingertips. Li Yuanqian was surprised to see that the strange green light on Huang Haitao's face had faded somewhat.
